description.narrative:
Project outcomes and impacts will be driven through increased access to climate finance in The Sultanate of Oman. As the second largest bank in the country, Sohar has a strong strategic commitment to support the Sultanate of Omans transition to NetZero through climate finance. This is further supported by a strong policy commitment by the government to prioritize and promote climate financing across the Sultanate.
At the market-level, as part of IFCs programmatic approach in the country designed to mainstream climate finance, the Project is expected to promote sustainability in the market by helping financial institutions in The Sultanate of Oman adopt international standards and best practices in climate finance (i.e., eligibility criteria, monitoring and reporting of climate assets).

The Project is a senior loan of up to US$200 million with a 5-year tenor (including a grace period of up to 3 years) to Sohar International Bank SAOG (Sohar or the Bank). IFCs own account investment is expected to be US$150 million, with the remaining to be financed by the Managed Co-Lending Portfolio Program (MCPP) for which IFC will act as the implementing entity. The use of proceeds for this Project is on-lending to eligible climate finance projects in The Sultanate of Oman including (but not limited to) renewable energy, energy efficiency and clean transportation.
